info.name: Gazebo — Locations & Products
info.description:
## Overview

Local Django microservice APIs for **locations/containers** and **products**.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`)

## Response envelope

```json
{
  "status": "success|error",
  "message": "...",
  "data": {}
}
```

## Product notes

- `GET /product/` lists active products.
- `POST /product/` creates a **core** product row (lookups + containers must already exist).
- Demo seed product: `id=900001` Peri Peri Burger (`python manage.py seed_demo_product`).
- Demo containers: `900001`–`900004`.
- Demo lookups: class/category/range/unit ids `9001` (+ unit case `9002`).

## Containers

Containers are `loc_location` rows. Use `GET /container/` for a flat list (useful for `source_container_id` / `destination_container_id`).

request.description:
### List all containers

`GET /container/`

Returns a flat list of all locations (containers) for FK selection when creating products.

**Query params**
| Param | Description |
|---|---|
| `q` | Filter by name (icontains) |
| `visible` | `true` / `false` |

**Success `data`**
- `count` — number of rows
- `results[]` — `{ id, container_id, name, external_code, visible, static, locked, roles }`
- `endpoints` — related route map

### Location tree list

`GET /container/locations/`

Richer hierarchy-oriented location listing (tree). Prefer `/container/` for simple product FK dropdowns.

### List products

`GET /product/`

Returns active products (`is_active=true`).

**Success `data`** — array of:
```json
{
  "id": 900001,
  "name": "Peri Peri Burger",
  "alternate_name": "PP Burger",
  "recipe_code": "PPB-001",
  "is_active": true,
  "product_class_id": 9001,
  "category_id": 9001,
  "range_id": 9001,
  "unit_id": 9001
}
```

### Get product detail

`GET /product/:id/`

Returns full core product fields including container FKs and timestamps.

**404** if product does not exist.

request.description:
### Create product

`POST /product/`

Creates a **core** `product` row only (no satellite tables yet).

#### Required body fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | int | Explicit PK (legacy-compatible) |
| `name` | string | Unique |
| `product_class_id` | int | Must exist |
| `category_id` | int | Must exist |
| `range_id` | int | Must exist |
| `unit_id` | int | Must exist |
| `source_container_id` | int | `GET /container/` |
| `destination_container_id` | int | `GET /container/` |

#### Optional
`alternate_name`, `recipe_code`, `alternate_recipe_code`, `gff_code`, `secondary_gff_recipe`, `external_barcode`, `is_active`, `is_downtime`, `purchasing_version`, `ingredient_count`, `remarks`, `sub_range_id`, `purchasing_unit_id`, `purchase_shape_format_id`

#### Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Validation / missing fields / bad FK |
| 409 | `id` already exists |

**Tip:** Call `GET /container/` first to pick container ids. Demo lookups use id `9001`.
